status: DONE. The cause is confirmed and fixed, the unit suites pass, the citations acceptance file passes (2 passed), and the fix is committed.
work_completed: Cause confirmed. The `_GLOB_TOKEN` regex took the sentence's trailing `.` into the token, so `_glob` built a pattern that needed `.md.` and matched nothing. In `citations` the matched token is now trimmed before it is checked: `.`, `:`, `!` and closing curly quotes (’ ” ») come off the end, and opening curly quotes (‘ “ «) come off the start. The hit span now covers only the trimmed glob, so it prints as found without the punctuation. Plain quotes, `,`, `;` and `)` already ended the token. The check for a literal first folder is unchanged, so `**/*` and `*.md` still are not citations. No other form changed.
